svg.title: Depth-first search on loop.mk: each node new, open or done, until the search meets an open node again
svg.text: loop.mk: diamond.mk, and two rules more
the path, goal at the bottom

g.title: enter app, the goal: it is open, the first node on the path.
enter liba: new, so the search opens it and puts it on the path, 1 edge below the goal.
enter common.h: new, so the search opens it and puts it on the path, 2 edges below the goal.
leave common.h: it needs nothing, so it is done at once, the first node finished.
leave liba: everything it needs is done, so it is done too; it comes off the path and goes on the end of the finished list.
enter libb: liba is done, so the search goes on along app's next edge, to libb, which is new.
again common.h: libb needs common.h, which is done already: a second way to it, not a cycle. The search does not go in again.
enter version.h: new, so the search opens it and puts it on the path, 2 edges below the goal.
cycle: version.h needs app, which is open: on the path. The path from app down to here is the cycle: make prints app -> libb -> version.h -> app and stops.
